# @rnw-community/react-native-collapsible-header

> Generic slot-based collapsible header for React Native and React Native Web, driven by a Reanimated shared scroll
> value. Works with `ScrollView`, `FlatList`, `SectionList`, FlashList, and LegendList; ships ESM + CJS precompiled
> with the React Compiler (React 18+) and peer-depends on `react-native-reanimated` (>=4.1.0 <5) on `react-native`
> (>=0.78).

Mount one `CollapsibleHeaderProvider` per scrollable inside each screen, never once around a navigator. Snapping needs
a mounted `CollapsibleHeader`, and only one header per provider may snap.

## Guides

- [Installation](readme.md#installation): Reanimated peer dependency and its Babel plugin setup.
- [React Compiler](readme.md#react-compiler): Precompiled output and the bundled `react-compiler-runtime`.
- [Quick start](readme.md#quick-start): Provider, header, and scrollable wired through context, plus manual `scrollY` wiring.
- [One provider per scrollable](readme.md#one-provider-per-scrollable): Provider scope and the shared-provider-across-screens mistake.
- [Snap requires a mounted CollapsibleHeader](readme.md#snap-requires-a-mounted-collapsibleheader): Why a provider alone never snaps.
- [Recipes](readme.md#recipes): `FlatList`, `SectionList`, FlashList, LegendList, other scrollables, and react-native-web wiring.
- [Testing consumers](readme.md#testing-consumers): Reanimated Jest setup and queries for the hidden layer.

## API reference

- [`CollapsibleHeader`](readme.md#collapsibleheader): Renders expanded, collapsed, and persistent slots in animated layers driven by the scroll offset.
- [`CollapsibleHeaderProps`](readme.md#collapsibleheaderprops): Geometry, mode, snap, overscroll, transition, motion, and per-layer style props of `CollapsibleHeader`.
- [`CollapsibleHeaderProvider`](readme.md#collapsibleheaderprovider): Owns `scrollY`, the scroll handler, the scroll ref, and the snap slot of one scrollable.
- [`useCollapsibleHeaderScroll`](readme.md#usecollapsibleheaderscroll): Returns the provider wiring `{ scrollY, onScroll, scrollRef }` for a scrollable.
- [`CollapsibleHeaderScroll`](readme.md#usecollapsibleheaderscroll): The `{ scrollY, onScroll, scrollRef }` shape returned by `useCollapsibleHeaderScroll`.
- [`CollapsibleHeaderScrollRef`](readme.md#collapsibleheaderscrollref): Animated ref type that attaches to any list ref shape without a cast.
- [`useCollapsibleHeaderProgress`](readme.md#usecollapsibleheaderprogress): Collapse progress shared value (0 expanded, 1 collapsed) for custom slot animations.
- [`getCollapsibleHeaderContentInsetStyle`](readme.md#getcollapsibleheadercontentinsetstyle): `{ paddingTop }` style for overlay-mode scroll content.
- [`DefaultCollapsibleHeaderMotionConfig`](readme.md#defaultcollapsibleheadermotionconfig): Baseline motion preset to spread into custom presets.
- [`CollapsibleHeaderMotionConfig`](readme.md#collapsibleheadermotionconfig): Normalized-progress thresholds and offsets of the header motion.
- [`CollapsibleHeaderCollapsedTransition`](readme.md#collapsibleheadercollapsedtransition): `'fade' | 'roll'` entrance of the collapsed layer.
- [`CollapsibleHeaderMode`](readme.md#collapsibleheadermode): `'flow' | 'overlay'` placement of the header relative to the scroll content.
